## Activity

During June 2019, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 362 captures. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume indicates that scheduled capture work continued without a reported disruption beyond this routine staffing arrangement.

The activity figure provides the overall number of captures completed at the site during the month. It is presented as the operational total for the reporting period and forms the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes.

## Image quality

There were 11 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 3.0 per cent. This measure is included to support ongoing review of image acquisition and to identify any need for further attention in capture practice. The result is reported alongside the total activity so that image quality can be considered in context.

## Grading

A total of 53 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and the time taken for results to progress through grading during June 2019. Overall, the report records completed activity, the proportion of images that could not be graded, and the volume of referable results for Harbour Eye Clinic.
